'''Turbothrust converter coils''' were components in [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that limited the amount of [[z]] buildup so the machine would not break down. They were in [[XP-38 sport landspeeder]]s, [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]]. The landspeeders carried a coil between V5 to V9 gauge while [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], needing to withstand more z buildup, carried V12 to V18 gauge.

==Behind the scenes==
Turbothrust converter coils were mentioned in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]''.
